Why I started Abundance

A useful tool begins with understanding someone’s day.

1 min read

We begin with people and the circumstances they live in. A tool that fits one person’s working day can get in someone else’s way. Before building, I want to understand what people already do and where they get stuck.

Abundance is a name for what a good tool can make more available: time, understanding, independence and the freedom to try something new. That can be as modest as a reader returning to a note or someone changing a plan without losing track of the day.

The work starts small. I hope to share what we try, invite feedback when it can change a decision, and be clear about what is ready to use.
